newsitem.title: POLAND: POLAND SELLS PLN 317 MLN FIXED BONDS AT TENDER.
newsitem.headline: POLAND SELLS PLN 317 MLN FIXED BONDS AT TENDER.

text.p: Poland sold 300 million zlotys of its 16-percent two-year bonds after investors bid for 431 million and 17 million zlotys of 12-percent five-year bonds after investors bid for 151 million, the treasury said.
The minimum price of the two-year bond, due on February 12, 1999, fell to 93.12 from 93.17 at the last fixed bond auction on October 17. The average price was 93.24 against 93.36.
The minimum price of the five-year paper, which matures on February 12, 2002, rose to 80.54 from 80.45 on October 17. The average price was 80.81 versus 80.56 at the last auction.
The settlement date of the shorter paper is December 5, 1996 and December 12, 1996 for the longer bond.
